purpose: Provide a symbolic per-cell/per-pair classifier over the sealed B1 complete local cover. Never materialize the global Cartesian product of grammar cells.

input_output_contract.input: One canonical B1 grammar cell plus one unordered pair of distinct positions (normally a nonconsecutive P7 chord obligation).
input_output_contract.runtime: classification(cell,pair) must run in time polynomial in the serialized extracted annotation size; no global grammar materialization is allowed.

lifecycle_firewall: B1 proved finite coverage for fixed s, not polynomial enumerability of the full product grammar.
B2 must be rule-driven/lazy. It may inspect only the supplied cell/pair plus constant-size C0 message data and declared local certificates.
No algorithm may enumerate 12138 role strings × 877 partitions × 2^21 graphs × remaining annotation products as part of classification.

statuses.source_status_semantics: OPTIONAL_LOCAL means neither bit is forbidden by the source constraints represented in the local cell. It is not a theorem that both alternatives have global source-valid realizations.

exact_objects.dynamic_palette: For dynamic u, chi_S(u), chi_X0(u), L_P(u)=[4]\chi_S(u), A(u)=[4]\(chi_S(u) union chi_X0(u)).
exact_objects.component_message: mu_C and MIN_BAD(C) are equivalent representations of the same monotone component function.
exact_objects.boundary_relation: For legal boundary coloring gamma, R_C(gamma)=mu_C(F_D(gamma)), where F_D(gamma)={gamma(v):v in D_C}.
exact_objects.exact_interface_firewall: Two raw distinctions may be collapsed only when every frozen downstream observation and reconstruction obligation factors through the retained invariant, following the sealed EXACT_INTERFACE adequacy pattern.

B_X0_palette_redundancy.premise: One endpoint is dynamic u, the other is fixed X0 identity of color c; compare presence/absence of that identity edge while all other fixed-color data are frozen.
B_X0_palette_redundancy.neutral_iff: c is already in chi_S(u) union chi_X0_without_this_identity(u).
B_X0_palette_redundancy.extension: PROVED_NEUTRAL for the final list-coloring relation because color c was already unavailable at u and no other graph relation changes.
B_X0_palette_redundancy.extension_if_new_color: UNKNOWN unless an exact downstream proof or distinguishing legal coloring is supplied.

C_X0_redundancy.premise: One endpoint is selected representative z in residual C, the other is fixed X0 identity of color c; compare that identity incidence only.
C_X0_redundancy.neutral_if: c remains present in chi_X0^C(z) after deleting this identity, i.e. another same-color X0 neighbor of z exists.
C_X0_redundancy.representation_if_neutral: IDENTITY_ONLY at the declared local base-list coordinate; B_C(z) unchanged.
C_X0_redundancy.extension_if_neutral: PROVED_NEUTRAL only when the certificate states that no other internal base-list coordinate or component relation is changed by this identity distinction. Then the whole component list system is unchanged, hence mu_C/MIN_BAD/R_C unchanged.
C_X0_redundancy.message_delta: UNKNOWN until recomputed/proved; never auto-promote to MESSAGE_CHANGE.

B_B_disjoint_palette.premise: Both endpoints are dynamic u,v and the distinction is exactly adjacency uv with all lists/other relations frozen.
B_B_disjoint_palette.extension: PROVED_NEUTRAL because every list-respecting coloring already has c(u)!=c(v), so the edge constraint is tautological. Exact reconstruction is unchanged.

B_C_boundary_relation.premise: Compare source-consistent states in which dynamic b is anticomplete versus complete to residual component C, with the same component message mu_C and all other declared boundary structure frozen. Thus D'_C=D_C union {b}.
B_C_boundary_relation.exact_criterion: R_C and R'_C are equal on every legal boundary coloring gamma iff mu_C(F_D(gamma))=mu_C(F_D(gamma) union {gamma(b)}) for every legal gamma.
B_C_boundary_relation.cheap_sufficient_neutrality: For every F subseteq [4] and every alpha in A(b), mu_C(F)=mu_C(F union {alpha}). Because the ground set has only 16 masks and 4 colors, this certificate is constant-time after message-table decode.
B_C_boundary_relation.extension_if_certificate: PROVED_NEUTRAL for the component extension relation, provided the comparison is source-consistent and no other downstream relation changes.
B_C_boundary_relation.nonneutrality: An abstract mask inequality is NOT enough. PROVED_NONNEUTRAL requires an explicit source-valid/legal boundary coloring gamma (or an exact reachability certificate) witnessing different R_C values.

further_rules: Same-component/different-component C-C distinctions are interpreted only after the B1 component partition is fixed; no single-edge repair semantics is allowed.
B-S, C-S, X0-S, S-S and other pair classes not covered by an exact neutrality theorem default to representation classification where possible and EXTENSION_DELTA=UNKNOWN.
An actual P7 chord is an already-present edge in the input. B2 classifies whether that structural distinction is downstream-redundant; it does not insert edges.
symbolic_classifier_requirements: Validate the supplied B1 cell locally; inconsistent cells return INCONSISTENT_CELL.
Classify the pair using only O(poly(serialized cell)) operations.
Decode a component message from one of the sealed 168 monotone tables in O(1) finite work.
Never enumerate boundary assignments for B-C neutrality when the universal 16×4 sufficient certificate applies.
Use UNKNOWN rather than infer NONNEUTRAL from representation change.
Every PROVED_NEUTRAL result must emit a compact replayable certificate identifying the exact rule and frozen coordinates.
Every PROVED_NONNEUTRAL result must emit a concrete legal/source-valid distinguishing witness or a separately sealed exact reachability certificate.

nonredundant_transition_id.name: kappa(cell,pair)
nonredundant_transition_id.definition: A canonical ID may merge raw pair distinctions only when a sealed adequacy proof shows identical frozen downstream relation/reconstruction contract. Otherwise distinct or UNKNOWN transitions remain separate.
nonredundant_transition_id.C5C_use: C5C may count only such proof-distinct nonredundant transition IDs, not raw graph edges.

terminals.PASS_SYMBOLIC_COMPLETE_CHORD_CLASSIFIER: For every B1 cell/pair input, the rule engine terminates in polynomial time with a sound source/representation/extension status; unsupported semantics returns UNKNOWN.
terminals.PASS_GLOBAL_NEUTRALITY_RULES: The universal B-X0 redundant-color, B-B disjoint-palette, and scoped C-X0 same-color-redundancy rules are theorem-sealed with replay certificates.
terminals.PASS_SOURCE_VALID_EXTENSION_NEUTRAL_WITN: A more complex class such as B-C has a real source-valid witness and exact boundary-relation equality.
terminals.PASS_SOURCE_VALID_EXTENSION_NONNEUTRAL_W: A real source-valid/legal boundary witness proves a distinction that the quotient must retain.
terminals.OPEN_EXTENSION_CLASS: Representation is classified but downstream extension effect is unresolved.

falsifiers: Classifier runtime depends on global grammar enumeration.
A PROVED_NEUTRAL output changes any frozen downstream observation or reconstruction obligation.
A B-C PROVED_NONNEUTRAL output is based only on an unreachable abstract mask/color pair.
C-X0 identity redundancy changes another internal base-list coordinate or component relation not included in its certificate.
A source-valid extracted cell/pair cannot be assigned a sound terminal status.

locks.C5C: LOCKED_UNTIL a proof-distinct nonredundant transition quotient exists for the complete local cover.
